subway-surfers-tokyo.title: Subway Surfers Tokyo: Play Free Online, Run Tokyo Streets
subway-surfers-tokyo.slogan: Run through the vibrant streets of Tokyo!
subway-surfers-tokyo.description: Experience the thrill of Subway Surfers Tokyo, an exciting endless runner game! Explore iconic locations, collect coins, and dodge trains. Play Subway Surfers Tokyo for free and discover Tokyo's unique charm. Subway Surfers Tokyo offers endless fun!

HomeIframe.title: Subway Surfers Tokyo
HomeIframe.description: Join the Subway Surfers World Tour in Tokyo!

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Subway Surfers Tokyo is a running game set in a virtual replica of Tokyo, Japan. Dodge trains, collect coins, and unlock characters!
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Swipe left or right to change lanes.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Swipe up to jump over obstacles.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Swipe down to slide under obstacles.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Experience the unique atmosphere of Tokyo with iconic landmarks.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Unlock special characters like Harumi, and outfits unique to the Tokyo edition.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Ride exclusive skateboards with Tokyo-themed designs, like the Cherry Blossom and Bamboo Sword boards.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Participate in unique, Japan-themed events such as the Cherry Blossom Festival.
